# LeakSanitizer suppressions for llcommon (the analysis workflow passes this file when it exists:
# .github/analysis/suppressions/<lib>-lsan.txt; see doc/clean/analysis.md). One reason per entry.
#
# The logging configuration watcher is allocated once, on purpose, and never freed: LLError::LogControlFile::
# fromDirectory() makes it with `new` (llerror.cpp, see the comment there). Logging runs during shutdown; freeing the
# watcher (an LLLiveFile with its Impl and its LiveFileEventTimer, which also owns a LLInstanceTracker entry) brings
# back destruction-order crashes. Every allocation of that chain has one of these frames.
leak:LogControlFile
leak:LiveFileEventTimer
# commonInit() is the logging start-up that calls fromDirectory() and LLLiveFile::addToEventTimer().
leak:LLError::commonInit
#
# The lazyeventapi test (test 3) registers a LazyEventAPI, whose constructor is the first getInstance() on the running
# coroutine in that process; the process ends without destroying the LLSingleton master list, so the one 24-byte
# 'initializing' list of the running coroutine is still allocated at exit (every other test binary frees it in
# ~MasterList(), and llsingleton test 16 runs 200 coroutines to show that finished coroutines free theirs). The pattern
# names this test's allocation path only, so a list leaked per coroutine anywhere else is still reported.
leak:LL::LazyEventAPIBase::LazyEventAPIBase
